cases.text: Your weekly digest is ready. See what's new in your network. If you no longer wish to receive these emails, please unsubscribe.
Sale ends Sunday! Take 30% off all shoes. Shop now. To stop receiving promotional emails, please click unsubscribe.
Your order #5521 has been delivered. We hope you enjoy it. Please do not reply to this automated message.
You have a new follower. View their profile. Manage your notification settings.
Please add our address to your contacts to make sure our emails reach your inbox.
Thanks for signing up to our newsletter! You'll receive updates monthly. You can unsubscribe at any time.
Join us for our online webinar series on gardening. Register now to save your spot. Unsubscribe from these emails.
A new device signed in to your account. If this was you, no action is needed.
Weekly roundup: top stories in education. Read more. Please forward this to a friend if you enjoyed it.
Your subscription renews automatically on 14 December. No action is needed.
Rate your recent stay. We'd love your feedback. Please take our two-minute survey.
Happy New Year from all of us!
Here is the agenda for your reference.
Your driver licence expires on 2 February 2027. Renew it online to avoid a fine.
Your child's immunisation record is out of date. Please book a catch-up appointment with your GP.
Rates notice: payment of $480.20 is due on 15/12/2026. Pay online or by BPAY. To stop receiving paper notices, please unsubscribe.
Can you collect Mia from netball on Thursday at 5pm?
Please complete the staff compliance training by 30 November.
The kids' swimming term fees are due next Friday.
Parents of Year 4 students who play an instrument may be eligible for a free lesson trial.
Just letting you know the library may be closed next week.
Your claim is being assessed. We'll email you once a decision has been made.
We're still waiting on your doctor's report. We'll be in touch when it arrives.
We've received your registration for the fun run. See you there!
Your payment of $35 was successful. Thank you.
Update: the school concert has been moved to Wednesday 9 December.
Heads up, tomorrow's training is cancelled.
